notes.title: v0.7.1.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
[h1]0.7.1.1 Hotfix[/h1]

Reverting the ramp fix change from v0.7.1 for now, until I figure out the super boost bug. Sorry about that!

notes.title: 0.7.1 Quick-Fixes Update
notes.notes:
Just updating some stuff to iron out some bumps for the game! Mostly features small fixes, most notably the movement improvements on ramps and a better Wallkicking camera.

I think this closes out the majority of the bugs left in the game! I'll be focusing on moving towards creating more content for our 1.0 release now. It's been really awesome seeing everyone share their progress and ridiculous runs in our discord, it's actually so cool I'm so happy everyone's enjoying the game so much <3

[h2]🏃‍♂️ Movement Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved wallkick viewkick control, now locks your viewkick for 0.1s and will smoothly cancel out if you are turning your mouse
[i]This should prevent a lot of weird bugs and loss of speed related to your camera viewkicking on wallkicks[/i]

[*]Improved velocity retention on leaving ramps
[i]Notable on Phoebe's Bridges, leaving ramps should have a much more predictable trajectory[/i]
[/list]

[h2]✨ Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Sliding, cont'd gold time increased from 14.5s to 15s
[*] Worlds on the level select now will unlock when completing the first level of that world
[*] This helps encourage exploring the hub between completing worlds, and talk to Momo!
[*] Added popup tutorial to City Gates about surfing
[*] Added level name to leaderboards when pulling the leaderboards up at the level finish screen
[*] Added medals to the top right level info in-game
[/list]

[h2]🔨 Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed exploit where you could retain speed when resetting after colliding with a short wall or sliding certain slopes
[*] Fixed time formatting on hour+ long runs
[*] Fixed a bridge in Phoebe's Bridges
[*] Fixed some supports in Feel The Breeze
[*] Fixed UI elements not clearing when re-entering the hub after loading a level
[*] Removed 'Query Failed' notifs, they weren't very informational
[*] Added in a missing track, to the middle of Seabreeze City go listen to it
[*] Disallowed menu buttons from being pressed while invisible (sorry Jade 😭 )
[/list]

notes.title: v0.7.0 Early Access Release Update!
notes.notes:
I'm so, so happy to say that CatboyZOOM is now available to everyone to play! We have poured in a ton of time and passion into this project and really hope you enjoy our humble silly movement game. This past year has been a year of incredible growth, and the reception for the game has been remarkable - it still feels a bit crazy how a bunch of people are so excited for something I'm creating, but I'm so glad I can be in this position creatively. If you try the game out, I kindly ask if you could leave a review on our Steam page, it helps us out a ton especially near release, as reviews push the visibility of the game further so more people can find us! Thank-you everyone so much for all your support!!! 💖💖💖

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[h2]✨ THE MAJOR STUFF[/h2]
[list]
[*] All four worlds are unlocked!
[*] Platinum medal times! These are hidden on each level until unlocked, and act as a stepping stone between Gold and Dev times
[*] World run timer! Complete an entire world in succession to achieve a full world run and track it on the leaderboards! Includes splits as well
[*] Friends leaderboards, so you can directly compare who is better
[*] Find your Catgirl twin! She should be somewhere in the world...
[*] Lots more Momo lore to discover
[*] Greatly extended the Hub!
[/list]

[h2]🏃‍♂️ Movement Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Improved surf behaviour to allow jumping on all surf ramp angles, but repeated jumps on surf ramps will have a very slight delay

[i]This change should help improve the feel of jumping on rocks and other slanted surfaces, while preventing abuse from bhopping on surf ramps[/i]

[*]Greatly improved wallkicking behaviour. They should now give you the appropriate amount of height when wallkicking, even off of uneven walls and rounded edges

[*] Improved auto-strafing mechanics to better keep you on surf ramps

[*] Bushes are now obstacles! They will slow you down if you run into them!

[*] Removed speedcap. Well, it's at 99999 now, if you can reach it 😼
[/list]

[h2]✨ Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted goal hitbox to better match goalpost model
[*] Added double-clicking to loading levels in the level select
[*] Added mouse invert to the options menu
[*] Adjustments to some levels in Momo's Island, mostly to prevent major skips that break the intent of the levels
[*] Name changes to the 'Sliding 10X' levels
[*] Added a skip to the intro cinematic on the title screen
[/list]

[h2]🔨 Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed velocity when leaving ramps while ground sliding not properly adjusting
[*] Fixed movement starting after releasing a movement key after reset if multiple movement keys are held down at time of reset, making the timer start unintentionally
[*] Fixed a bug that gave way too much height when jumping off of ramps
[*] Fixed sliding particle effects not appearing sometimes
[*] Fixed player having input control while in the pause menu (prevents a softlock!)
[/list]

[h2]🗺️ On the Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*] Savestate system
[*] Replays & ghosts
[*] More worlds!
[*] More friends?
[/list]

notes.title: v0.6.0 Leaderboards n' Wallkick Update
notes.notes:
Hiya everyone! This update has been massive in terms of getting major functionality into the game. We finally fully support Steam Leaderboards! You will now automatically submit times for every PR you get on every level, if connected to Steam, and can browse against every other time submitted to the game. We'll be adding filtering for your friends list in the future, as well as submitting times for full World (and game) runs!
We've also listened to your feedback of wanting more height control in the game, so with that we've implemented a Wallkick feature that y'all can play around (and break a few levels) with!

Alongside that, behind the scenes I've been cleaning up our art pipeline, making lots of headway on polishing up the other unrelased worlds for our Early Access release, and prepping the game so we can add other playable characters and doing more worldbuilding (catgirl incoming??)

Another BIG change is you can now [i][b]leave a Steam review on our demo![/b][/i] If you've tried the demo and enjoyed it, please consider leaving a review there, we'd appreciate it a ton~!! We'll be preparing our demo for the upcoming Steam Next Fest later in October, and hoping that helps us kick off our Early Access release!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3041880/catboyZOOM_Demo/

[i]Leaderboards on pre-release versions are temporary! It's also recommended that you clear your personal save, to avoid any issues.[/i]

As always, thanks for playing~!

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[h2]THE MAJOR STUFF[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Global Leaderboards! Leave your best time for every level and compete against others!
[*]Added Wallkicking! Go break some levels ;3
[*]Fresh new look and animations for our catboy protagonist
[*]A full new level added to Momo's Island, rounding it out to 15 full levels present in the demo
[/list]
[h2]Movement Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added Wallkicking! Hold space while in-air to prep for a Wallkick when you hit a vertical wall, or press space while against a wall to kick off of it!
[i]Kicking off a wall reflects your current velocity against the wall you're hitting, as well as giving you a vertical boost. You can more height off a Wallkick based on your angle of approach, so hitting a wall straight-on will give you much more height than hitting it from a shallow angle, but you will also sacrifice more horizontal speed for that extra height[/i]

[*]Added 'skimming' which alleviates the behaviour of bumping platform edges
[i]When bumping the edge of a platform, your speed will re-correct itself if you clear the platform's corner soon after bumping. This prevents a lot of frustrating corner bumps which can launch you unpredictably. This also prevents some inconsistent strats that relied on edge bumping[/i]

[*]Speed boosts from falling on the ground sliding will now apply shortly overtime
[i]This incentivizes sliding on the ground more, as opposed to just gaining speed through constantly slide jumping[/i]
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]New model for the Catboy, along with a slew of animation improvements!
[*]Improved sliding dust particles
[*]Some balance changes to the tutorial levels
[*]Added Momo dialogue to the level Rebound
[*]Added tutorial text popups on the first world of levels, helping onboard players who don't like listening to Momo :momoZOOM:
[*]Implemented VSync (found in options)
[*]Allowed closing the Pause menu using 'esc'
[*]Added a fancy medal colour for dev times!
[*]Updated dev times ;3
[*]Added a strafe helper, which shows an arrow pointing towards your heading velocity. This can help with learning optimal strafing angles
[*]Added an 'are you sure?' confirmation when clearing saves
[/list]
[h2]Fixed[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed slide bar not resetting when momentarily in-air
[*]Fixed coyote jumps sometimes occuring when they shouldn't
[*]Fixed clipping on crouch animations
[*]Fixed not crouching when there isn't enough space to stand
[*]Fixed max fps not properly setting
[*]Fixed animations not resetting properly when resetting in-air
[*]Fixed minor softlock after opening the feedback menu
[*]Fixed lots of bugs from the test build version for Wallkicking and Leaderboard queries
[/list]
[h2]On The Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*]World times implementation! Race to beat an entire world of levels
[*]Replays on leaderboard entries!
[*]Racing against ghosts from leaderboards!
[*]Polishing up the rest of the game for Early Access
[*]More playable characters and outfits :3
[/list]
